heading: Security Through Precision & Deep Systems Analysis
bioParagraphs: I am an aspiring cybersecurity professional and security researcher exploring both offensive and defensive security, with hands-on interests in penetration testing, vulnerability research, security operations, and threat detection.

I like understanding how things work by taking them apart, testing them, and seeing where they break. Most of my learning comes from working on real projects, doing CTFs, experimenting with different security tools, and building my own labs. I’m always trying to learn something new and turn what I learn into something practical.

focusAreas.title: Penetration Testing & Offensive Security
focusAreas.description: Hands-on experience with web application testing, network enumeration, vulnerability identification, and basic exploitation through labs, CTFs, and practical assessments.

focusAreas.title: Web & Mobile (Android) Security
focusAreas.description: Exploring web and Android application security through static and dynamic analysis, Burp Suite, Frida, MobSF, and manual testing.

focusAreas.title: Active Directory & Network Security
focusAreas.description: Building and testing Active Directory environments, working with Kerberos, SMB, privilege escalation, enumeration, and common AD attack techniques.

focusAreas.title: SOC & Defensive Security
focusAreas.description: Interested in security monitoring, SIEM, incident analysis, log investigation, and understanding how attacks can be detected and responded to.

philosophy: Understand how a system works, find where it can fail, and learn how to make it more secure. I believe practical testing, curiosity, and continuous learning are key to good security.
